name: quality-kernel
description: A quality-assurance kernel for agentic development. Ships a deterministic quality GATE (/gate): a risk router (blast-radius tiering from a critical-surface config, read from the base ref) + a commit-anchored re-executing referee that verifies a committed base..head with an INVERTED trusted tree (the immutable base harness — tests, runners, configs — run against the head's production code) PLUS a mandatory head-as-is run, so file-tampering (neuter/delete/rename/re-golden/runner-swap/symlink) cannot force a green; an optional human-approved acceptance oracle adds an independent check. Rebuilt after an independent red-team panel broke v1 (see docs/agentic-harness/validation-panel). Honest limit: an in-process test oracle cannot stop production code that subverts it in-process — that is the M2 live breaker's job. Composes with the six-agent SwarmForge engine, deterministic tools (CRAP, mutation, DRY), and epistemic-discipline hooks.
